tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: Shield green from the crest. Website section bands, the app header, the dashboard sidebar. Text on it uses on-pitch.

tokens.name: pitch-deep
tokens.usage: The poster wall: website hero and match-day panels. Carries floodlight headlines and on-pitch text.

tokens.name: pitch-stripe
tokens.usage: Mowing stripes laid over pitch in bands. Decoration only, never behind small text.

tokens.name: crest-gold
tokens.usage: Gold from the crest. Badges, streaks, trophies, the website's secondary buttons. Text on it uses on-gold.

tokens.name: floodlight
tokens.usage: Poster headline colour on pitch-deep and pitch, and primary website CTA fill. Never on cream: it fails contrast there.

tokens.name: grass
tokens.usage: Done, coming, paid, read. App progress fills and the primary app button. Text on it uses on-grass.

tokens.name: grass-lip
tokens.usage: The 4px bottom lip under grass buttons in the app.

tokens.name: grass-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for done states, completed to-dos and the 'read' pill.

tokens.name: grass-text
tokens.usage: Green text on cream, paper and grass-tint: 'Read', 'Paid', 'Yes'.

tokens.name: kit-orange
tokens.usage: The one signal colour: needs action, unread, missing, overdue. Text on cream and paper, or a fill with on-orange text.

tokens.name: orange-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for needs-action rows, flagged check-ins and the 'missing' pill. Text on it is kit-orange or ink.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for badge rows, streak callouts and the unread announcement card.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold text on cream, paper and gold-tint: streak counts, badge names, 'Player of the Week'.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere, taken from the crest's background. Body text is ink.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, table rows and inputs sitting on cream.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines and card borders on cream and paper. Dashboard tables use only this, no shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on cream, paper and the tints.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table headers on cream, paper and the tints.

tokens.name: on-pitch
tokens.usage: Text and icons on pitch and pitch-deep.

tokens.name: on-pitch-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on pitch and pitch-deep.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on crest-gold and floodlight fills.

tokens.name: on-grass
tokens.usage: Text on grass fills: the app's primary button, progress labels.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text on kit-orange fills: count bubbles, 'Chase' buttons.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px keyboard focus outline on every control, always paired with the focus-halo ring so it shows on cream and on pitch.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: 2px ring drawn inside the focus outline.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Dashboard chart series 1 (blue): identity only, e.g. one age group's line. Never text, never status. Always with a legend or direct label.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Dashboard chart series 2 (magenta). Same rules as chart-1. Slots are used in order; the order is what keeps neighbours apart for colour-blind readers.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Dashboard chart series 3 (violet). Same rules as chart-1.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Dashboard chart series 4 (mustard). Same rules as chart-1. Four series at most: past that, chart the club overall.

styles.name: poster-xl
styles.usage: Website hero headline only, floodlight on pitch-deep. One per page.

styles.name: poster-m
styles.usage: App screen titles and card headlines on the website.

styles.name: scoreline
styles.usage: Big numbers: shirt numbers, headcounts, scores, dashboard hero figures.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: New away kit: sizes needed by Friday

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: List headings, row titles, button labels at 16–17px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Please confirm Yusuf's size so we can place the bulk order.
styles.usage: Running text in all three products.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Bobby Moore Sports Hub, Dagenham RM9 5PU

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, pill text, table headers.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Dashboard cells and any numbers in columns. Always with tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, pill padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside compact rows and between pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Dashboard cell padding, list gaps in the app.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: App card padding and the phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Website card padding, dashboard panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between dashboard panels and website card rows.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Website side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between website sections.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Dashboard: tables, inputs, small buttons. Flat and precise.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Website: cards, photos, CTA buttons.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: App: cards, sheets and chunky buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, avatars, badges.

tokens.name: lip-grass
tokens.usage: Under grass buttons in the app: the pressable lip. Pressed state drops it to 0 and moves the button down 4px.

tokens.name: lip-neutral
tokens.usage: Under paper buttons and selectable cards in the app.

tokens.name: lip-gold
tokens.usage: Under floodlight and crest-gold buttons.
